basis: Spinal neural-tube and vertebral closure defects; urinary dysfunction estimates from open forms cannot establish common direct urinary damage across the isolated umbrella.

decisions.renal: none: neurogenic bladder is a separately diagnosed consequence; direct urinary tract damage in ≥30% across open and occult forms is not established.

basis: Heart, developmental and digital abnormalities define syndrome; hearing impairment 26/49. Eyelid malformations 33/42 omitted at cap in favor of functional hearing loss.

decisions.ocular: none: eyelid malformations occur in 33/42, but are omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of functionally significant hearing impairment in 26/49.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: digital skeletal abnormalities are a defining component; clinodactyly 3/7 and pectus carinatum 17/42 support skeletal involvement.

basis: Beta2-microglobulin amyloid deposition predominantly damages bones, joints and tendons; amyloid-related compressive neuropathy is a major manifestation (~30–50%). Renal failure is antecedent.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: a protein handling and deposition disorder, supported by its amyloidosis and proteostasis-deficiency ancestry.

basis: Hantavirus infection causes pulmonary capillary leak and respiratory failure; myocardial depression with circulatory failure occurs in roughly 30–50%.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: myocardial depression and circulatory failure affect roughly 30–50%; this is direct cardiac dysfunction rather than an isolated transient blood-pressure sign.

basis: DOK7-related neuromuscular-junction failure causes fetal akinesia and fixed deformities; pulmonary hypoplasia is a major FADS feature, although subtype-specific frequency is unquantified.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary hypoplasia is a major defining malformation of fetal akinesia deformation sequence; DOK7-specific frequency is unquantified.

basis: Neuromuscular/neurodevelopmental disease with defining ocular or auditory anomalies. Individual retinal and hearing findings are reported in 1/4; destructive muscle findings also 1/4.

decisions.ocular: primary: ocular anomalies are a defining named component, with structural retinal abnormalities documented; individual 1/4 findings do not establish total ocular frequency.
decisions.otologic: primary: auditory anomalies are a defining named alternative, with sensorineural hearing impairment documented in 1/4; the involved-organ frequency threshold does not govern primary features.

basis: SCID defined by deficient T-cell numbers and function; lymphopenia occurs in 30–79%. Site-specific infections and hepatitis occur in only 5–29% and are separately diagnosed infections.

decisions.haematologic: primary: deficient T-cell development and numbers constitute a blood-cell disorder; decreased total lymphocytes and T cells are frequent (30–79%).

basis: GPI defect with encephalopathy; oral overgrowth 75–100%, skeletal defects 50–100%. Hearing loss 2/6 omitted at cap; cerebral visual loss is neurologic; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: digital skeletal abnormalities occur in 3/4–4/4 and other skeletal defects in 2/4; their higher frequency supports retention at the cap.
decisions.otologic: none: hearing impairment in 2/6 meets 30%, but is omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of more prevalent oral and skeletal abnormalities.

basis: Tumor originates in the stomach. Gastrin production alone does not establish an endocrine disorder; associated Zollinger–Ellison syndrome is optional and separately diagnosed.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: gastric neuroendocrine-cell origin and gastrin production alone do not establish endocrine-gland disease or a metabolic disorder; Zollinger–Ellison syndrome is optional.

basis: Congenital hearing loss defines syndrome; temporal hypotrichosis and tongue/palate anomalies occur in 80–99%, PDA in 30–79%. Evidence derives from one family.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: temporal hypotrichosis occurs in 80–99%, representing persistent hair abnormality; it is an associated feature rather than a defining diagnostic component.
